sources.section: Document Management - Institutional Repository and Digital Library Software
sources.entry: EPrints - Digital document management system with a flexible metadata and workflow model primarily aimed at academic institutions. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 Perl

summary.one_liner: GNU EPrints is a document management system for institutional repositories, aimed mainly at higher education, written in Perl.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes EPrints as a document management system aimed at higher education institutions and individuals. It states that it has been used to provide Open Access to research results, share educational resources, and host portfolios of work. It has a flexible metadata and workflow model and is said to interact with other Web and institutional systems. The README itself is short and mostly covers licensing and contact details, so it gives little detail on specific features or installation steps.
use_cases: managing academic publications with custom metadata and workflows
how_to_run: See the installation guide referenced in the README (the README links to external documentation)
notable: Used for Open Access research repositories
Developed at the University of Southampton
caveats: README is brief and points to external documents for installation and support
